_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_offer_emit.py's offer-emit.json (BC-12702, ADR-028 eval #3). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties: false, items, enum, const. This asserts the matrix SHAPE (every row carries the same key set + types). It is DISTINCT from the canonical's structural validity, which lint_canonicals.py owns (its exit code is baked into each write row's lint.exit_code and asserted by the golden). appended_offer/lint are left type-only ([object,null]) so the golden + golden_compare lock their (per-branch, heterogeneous) values: a write row carries an appended_offer object + lint{exit_code}; a rejection row carries null for both + a non-null error string.
